_doc: Ratchets on the files that only ever grow. `node tools/check/ratchets.mjs` checks, `--update` snaps every ceiling to the current value (lower after an extraction; a raise is a deliberate edit with its reason in the commit). Metrics: lines (split-newline), codeLines (non-comment non-blank), gMembers (G facade members, check-gctx), topLets (column-0 `let`). History: docs/notes/CEILING-HISTORY.md.
